evals.prompt: Our .NET 8 BackgroundService on Windows App Service sometimes dies during startup before anything reaches Application Insights. Review our proposed observability setup and describe the source-controlled Azure and application changes needed.
evals.expected_output: Covers early host telemetry wiring, durable App Service diagnostic settings, bounded non-production filesystem logging, detailed errors, failed-request tracing, and reversible time-bounded escalation controls.

evals.prompt: Add a production-safe observability baseline to a Linux App Service worker deployment. We need useful incident diagnostics without claiming Windows-only features work.
evals.expected_output: Uses Application Insights plus console/application resource logs and a durable sink, explicitly identifies detailed errors and failed-request tracing as Windows-only, and keeps temporary controls bounded and source-controlled.

evals.prompt: A teammate enabled verbose App Service logs manually in the portal last week. Define a safer repeatable escalation and rollback contract for the repository.
evals.expected_output: Defaults escalation off and requires reviewed IaC, ownership, incident linkage, expiry, bounded retention, verification, and an explicit rollback to off.
